newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close mostly lower.

text.p: CME lumber futures remained under pressure from reports of slow cash trade and closed mostly lower, traders said.
Lumber closed off $3.80 to up $2.10 per tbf with July off $2.10 at $385.40 and September off most at $377.00.

Cash sources said spruce was actually trading in the $360 to $370 per tbf range which put futures at a premium. Lumber production has remained too large for demand and seasonal mill closings have been running behind expectations. This, and resistance after the recent price advance, weighed on futures, traders said.
Liquidation continued in July ahead of its spot position next week, they added.
